description: Transcribe the speech in a TikTok video to text from its link. The spoken language is detected automatically. Usually takes 20 to 60 seconds. Free use is limited per day and per video length; if the transcription is not finished when this call returns, it gives a job_id for get_transcription_result.

timestamps.description: Prefix every line with its start time, like [0:12]. Defaults to false.

url.description: Link to a TikTok video, for example https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/7300000000000000000 or a vm.tiktok.com share link.

name: transcribe_tiktok_video
title: Transcribe TikTok video
